summary: The First Den is a cozy forest world centered on Spawn and a lakeside home, with roads reaching Lumenvale and Hearthmere. The main place combines configured forest terrain with authored settlements, wildlife and homestead life; procedural generators build structures and grounds dressing while managers animate residents and interactions, and Sage makes scheduled low flights around the home grounds.
places: places/main - sole live place; forest-terrain, configured terrain/site/road marks and seeded forest decoration, with authored cells across Spawn and distant settlements

places/main/cells/x0z0.scene - Spawn/home clearing: cob-house and portal, garden, catio, coop/flock, hives, den folk and managers; now includes the grounds plan, yard dressing, deer-fence sections and Sage manager
places/main/cells/x0z-1.scene + x-1z-1.scene + x-1z0.scene - nearby wildlife, rescue pasture and corn maze; deer-fence runs/gates are distributed across the neighboring cells
places/main/cells/objects.scene - shared/authored object placement collection for the main place
roots: world.config.yaml - multiplayer entry/default main place, player/camera templates, lighting, arrival and UI
templates/player.js#player - composed player movement, gait, home interaction and delete-mode behaviors
templates/camera.js#camera - custom first-/third-person camera; long far clip for distant mountain range
places/main/config.yaml - forest terrain, Spawn gravity, site/path marks and procedural decoration bindings
places/main/cells/x0z0.scene#cob-house - procedural multi-level house at (0, 0.5, -26), cellar through roof deck; greenery and roofbloom are child parts
places/main/cells/x0z0.scene#grounds-plan - authored flag-walk network at the home grounds; terrain paths in config provide lawn, mulch and grading underneath
places/main/cells/x0z0.scene#sage-dragon - manager behavior scripts/sage-dragon.js; temporary flying actor sage is created only during a flight
places/main/cells/x0z-1.scene#pasture-site + #corn-maze + #maze-start + #maze-heart-zone - fenced rescue pasture, four horses and timed maze triggers
shared: scripts/forest-terrain.js - main heightAt/materialAt(ctx) contract for terrain and terrain-relative placements
scripts/gen/forest-plant.js + scripts/gen/valley-mesh.js - seeded forest vegetation builders reused across decoration layers
scripts/lib/road-solid.js - shared solid geometry for bridge, roadside and deer-fence generators
scripts/lib/yard-kit.js - geometry/material primitives reused by yard-fence, yard-furnish, vine-arch and flower-bed generators
scripts/lib/home-interaction.js + scripts/lib/data/home-feel.js - player press targeting and home-interaction tuning
scripts/lib/data/player.yml + scripts/lib/data/ropes.js - player movement, flight and rope tuning used by player behavior
scripts/lib/data/sage.yml + scripts/lib/sage-route.js + scripts/lib/dragon-wave.js - Sage's measured route/tuning and reusable dragon body-wave animation
scripts/lib/data/catio.yml + scripts/gen/catio-layout.js - cat roster, perches, links, rest timing and door tuning for catio manager/actors
notableExports: scripts/forest-terrain.js - GROUND, SITES, LAKE, heightAt(ctx), materialAt(ctx)
scripts/player.js - onSpawn(ctx), onInput(ctx,input), update(ctx,dt); scripts/camera.js - finiteNumber(value,fallback), update(ctx,dt)
scripts/gen/cob-house.js - HOUSE, holesFor(k), geometry(ctx), collider(ctx); geometry dispatches roofbloom/greenery child parts

scripts/sage-dragon.js - updateSchedule, onSpawn(ctx), fly(ctx), ears['sage:fly'], update(ctx); scripts/lib/sage-route.js - routeLength(), at(ctx,s,total), pose(ctx,s,total); scripts/lib/dragon-wave.js - waveClip(w,name)
scripts/gen/deer-fence.js - geometry(ctx), collider(ctx) for run and gate; scripts/gen/yard-fence.js - geometry(ctx), collider(ctx)
scripts/gen/vine-arch.js - LANTERN_DROP, dims(p), lanternY(p), geometry(ctx), collider(ctx); scripts/gen/yard-furnish.js - geometry(ctx), collider(ctx)
scripts/catio-cats.js - update(ctx); scripts/coop-flock.js - updateSchedule, update(ctx,dt); scripts/pasture-herd.js - updateSchedule, update(ctx,dt)
scripts/maze-run.js - onTriggerEnter(ctx,other); scripts/secret.js - ears.press for discoverable keepsakes
ownership: places/main/config.yaml + scripts/forest-terrain.js - terrain seed/material/site marks, scatter and derived ground height/material; config now adds home lawn, mulch, clearing and outbuilding path/flatten marks
places/main/cells/*.scene - authored row IDs, locations, tags, initial state and fixed structure/actor relationships
scripts/player.js + scripts/lib/data/player.yml - movement intent, velocity, jump, flight and rope behavior; high-frequency scratch in ctx.session
scripts/humanoid-locomotion.js + scripts/camera.js - player yaw/gait channels and camera view/eye/local-player visibility
scripts/fauna-ground.js / scripts/fauna-small.js - movement, animation and pet/follow behavior for their tagged populations
scripts/sage-dragon.js - manager flight schedule/state and temporary Sage actor lifecycle; sage.yml owns flight intervals, route and appearance tuning
scripts/catio-cats.js - cat perch/route/mode/animation state; catio-cat.js owns each cat's name/coat/pet response; door script owns latch/open motion
scripts/coop-flock.js - shared flock motion/clip timers in ctx.session; coop-nest.js owns egg count/open timestamp, coop-gate.js owns gate pose
flows: places/main/config.yaml terrain generator + seed -> scripts/forest-terrain.js heightAt/materialAt(ctx) -> engine terrain, river channels and forest material bands
places/main/config.yaml site/path marks + decorations -> terrain clearing/grading/material features and seeded vegetation builders; home grounds paths now lay yard lawn/mulch and clear scatter
road marks in places/main/config.yaml -> route corridors; authored cells add bridges, dressing, signs and rest features toward Lumenvale/Hearthmere
move/look/jump/camView input -> scripts/player.js -> movement, jump, flight and camMode; place gravity applies to player body
movement near rope coordinates -> scripts/player.js + lib/data/ropes.js -> climb/slide velocity and deck step-in; player body/camMode -> camera view and visibility
interact input -> scripts/home-player-feel.js + lib/home-interaction.js -> nearest aligned press; pet press writes petAt/petBy for fauna/catio/pasture response

sage-dragon manager onSpawn -> schedules flight from sage.yml; update -> sage-route pose + dragon-wave clip -> temporary sage row, sound and trail; sage:fly ear or flyReq state poke launches immediately
grounds-plan row -> scripts/gen/grounds-flags.js builds non-colliding flag paths; placed yard-fence/furnish and vine-arch rows use their generator params for ground dressing
deer-fence tagged scene rows -> scripts/gen/deer-fence.js run/gate geometry and colliders; fence sections span cells and leave authored gate openings for roads/maze access
catio-site update -> scripts/catio-cats.js reads catio.yml and PERCHES/LINKS, updates three cat rows and clips; cat press -> name/sound/hearts and pet state -> happy pose
coop-site update -> scripts/coop-flock.js moves tagged coop-bird children and sets anim/coop-hen clips/sounds; coop-gate proximity -> auto-swing; nest press -> egg count, lid motion and feedback
pasture-site manager -> scripts/pasture-herd.js reads nearby players and pasture.yml, moves four horse rows within yard/keep-out bounds; horse press -> petAt and name/story feedback
behaviorFamilies: places/main/config.yaml decoration layers + scripts/gen/forest-plant.js / valley-mesh.js - seeded forest plants, trees, shrubs, ferns and reeds varied by layer, kind and terrain
scripts/gen/cob-house.js - procedural multi-level house geometry/collider with cellar, spiral stair and roof deck; distinct greenery and seeded roofbloom parts are non-colliding
scripts/gen/road-bridge.js + scripts/lib/road-solid.js - reusable bridge geometry/collider varied by dimensions and seed
scripts/gen/animal-{bear,deer,fox,wolf}.js + scripts/fauna-ground.js - shared large-fauna manager varied by species, individual state and appearance
scripts/gen/critter-{bird,duck,rabbit,squirrel}.js + scripts/fauna-small.js - shared small-critter manager with species geometry and animation
scripts/catio-cats.js + scripts/gen/cat.js - three cat actors share perch navigation/animation and pet response, varied by roster, coat, pitch and starting perch
scripts/coop-flock.js + scripts/gen/coop-hen.js - seven hens/rooster share bounded flock motion and clip behavior, varied by variant and kind

scripts/gen/deer-fence.js, yard-fence.js, yard-furnish.js, vine-arch.js - grounds structures reuse generator geometry across placed rows, varied by route points, segment style, furnishing/frame and blossom parameters
probableOrphans: scripts/flat-terrain.js - no current place config selects it; main uses forest-terrain
scripts/jade-dragon.js - no scene row attaches this actor behavior; sky flights and Sage use scripts/gen/jade-dragon.js geometry directly
scripts/gen/flower-bed.js - no current scene or other package file references this generator
migrationNotes: forest-terrain.js heightAt/materialAt take a context object; main's river is at sea level y=0, ground is around y=0.5, and Spawn clearing is centered near (0,-3).

Keep places/main/config.yaml material IDs, clear/flatten marks and decoration bindings coordinated; home grounds are centered near (0,-35), workshop at (17,-41), studio at (-19,-36), glasshouse at (14,-56), pasture at (-38,-73), coop at (27,-28), hive at (31,-46), and maze at (-8,-127).
The active cob-house at (0,0.5,-26) must stay aligned with homeSite/homeClear terrain marks; local levels and openings are defined by HOUSE/holesFor in cob-house.js.
grounds-plan paths and configured terrain path marks have separate jobs: terrain marks grade/materialize lawn and walks; the scene generator draws flagstone walks and hub rings and has no collider.

Sage's measured world-space loop and entry/exit are in scripts/lib/data/sage.yml; route altitude is above max(ground, sea), and the manager's temporary actor ID is sage, distinct from persistent manager row sage-dragon.

Pasture fence loop dimensions must agree with pasture.yml herd site bounds/keep-outs; deer-fence gate gaps must remain aligned with roads and maze access; catio-layout positions are manager-yaw local while den-folk chore stops are world-space.
